use_case_summary: Core ask: Replace rule-based suggestions with LLM agent-assist while guaranteeing deterministic response under burst load. Secondary: automated ticket summarization and tool-calling (CRM updates) after call wrap-up. Must survive incident spikes and seasonal peaks with controlled queue backpressure and graceful degradation.
performance_requirements: Agent-assist: median latency <= 150-200ms (token streaming), p95 <= 350ms; Throughput: support 2k-5k concurrent agent sessions during peak; Summarization jobs can be async (batch) but SLA for daily backlog clearance <= 12 hours.
model_preferences: Mix of small quantized models for real-time suggestions + larger models for long-form summarization. Want model catalog visibility, ability to pin versions, and automated fallback to cached heuristics when latency SLOs at risk.
routing_and_fallback_needs: Multi-tier routing: primary low-latency dedicated pool, secondary hosted fallback in separate region, automatic degrade to short canned responses or local heuristics under heavy backpressure. Circuit-breaker + priority routing for VIP customers.
security_notes: Requires VPC peering for private deployments, bring-your-own-key (KMS/HSM) mandatory, full audit logs for every API call. PCI scope must be minimized — prefer tokenization at ingestion. Asked for encryption-at-rest and in-flight certificates docs.
poC_success_criteria: 1) No impact to agent median latency under 2k simulated concurrent agents; 2) Failover to fallback model with <1% degraded agent UX during induced infra failure; 3) Accurate ticket summarization (ROUGE > baseline and human acceptability >85%); 4) Clear KMS integration and SOC2 evidence provided.
